# The Wandering Bar

> Upscale mobile bar service based in the Shuswap/Kamloops area of Interior BC, Canada. Custom cocktails, mocktails, specialty coffee, and curated beverage experiences for weddings, private events, and celebrations.

The Wandering Bar operates vintage horse-trailer-converted mobile bars, staffed with professional bartenders, serving weddings and private events across Kamloops, Shuswap, Okanagan, and the BC Interior.

## Services

- [Packages & Pricing](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#packages): Mobile bar service packages for weddings and events
- [Gallery](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#gallery): Photos of past events and trailer setups
- [Dry Hire](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#dry-hire): Bar trailer rental without bartending staff
- [FAQ](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#faq): Common questions about booking, pricing, and service area
